newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products flat but mogas well bid at $193.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products flat but mogas well bid at $193.

text.p: Oil products were little changed in early trading on Tuesday, traders said.

Gasoline was well bid after edging tentatively higher on Monday but no early trade was heard. Bids for Rotterdam barges were pegged at $192 fob for restricted location and at $193 for running refinery production.

May swaps were bid at just above $196 off crack spreads but nearer $195 outright. Gas oil was 50 cents a tonne higher on futures but barge premiums were unchanged at parity to just over the $165.50 tonne on May IPE contract. High sulphur fuel barges were bid at $81 by traders but offered at $82 by two refiners.
